parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the Redis cache.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --sku
parameters.help: Type of Redis cache.

parameters.name: --vm-size
parameters.help: Size of Redis cache to deploy. Basic and Standard Cache sizes start with C. Premium Cache sizes start with P.

parameters.name: --disable-access-keys
parameters.help: Authentication to Redis through access keys is disabled when set as true.

parameters.name: --enable-non-ssl-port
parameters.help: If specified, then the non-ssl redis server port (6379) will be enabled.

parameters.name: --mi-system-assigned
parameters.help: Flag to specify system assigned identity.

parameters.name: --mi-user-assigned
parameters.help: One or more space separated resource IDs of user assigned identities.

parameters.name: --minimum-tls-version
parameters.help: Specifies the TLS version required by clients to connect to cache.

parameters.name: --redis-configuration
parameters.help: A json file used to set redis-configuration settings. You may encounter parse errors if the json file is invalid. Usage: --redis-configuration @"{config_file.json}" An example json file for configuring max-memory policies [ { "maxmemory-policy": "allkeys-lru" } ] An example json file for enabling the RDB back up data persistence is [ { "rdb-storage-connection-string": "DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=mystorageac count;AccountKey=myAccountKey;EndpointSuffix=core.windows.net", "rdb-backup-enabled": "true", "rdb-backup-frequency": "15", "rdb-backup-max-snapshot-count": "1" } ] An example json file for enabling the AOF back up data persistence is [ { "aof-backup-enabled": "true", "aof-storage-connection-string-0": "DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=mystorage account;AccountKey=myAccountKey;EndpointSuffix=core.windows.net", "aof-storage-connection-string-1": "DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=mystorage account;AccountKey=myAccountKey;EndpointSuffix=core.windows.net" } ] The content for a json file for configuring Microsoft Entra Authentication is { "aad-enabled": "true", }.

parameters.name: --redis-version
parameters.help: Redis version. This should be in the form 'major[.minor]' (only 'major' is required) or the value 'latest' which refers to the latest stable Redis version that is available. Supported versions: 4.0, 6.0 (latest). Default value is 'latest'.

parameters.name: --replicas-per-master
parameters.help: The number of replicas to be created per master.

parameters.name: --shard-count
parameters.help: The number of shards to be created on a Premium Cluster Cache.

parameters.name: --static-ip
parameters.help: Specify a static ip if required for the VNET. If you do not specify a static IP then an IP address is chosen automatically.

parameters.name: --subnet-id
parameters.help: The full resource ID of a subnet in a virtual network to deploy the redis cache in. Example format /subscriptions/{subid}/resourceGroups/{res ourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.{Network|Clas sicNetwork}/virtualNetworks/vnet1/subnets/subnet1.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --tenant-settings
parameters.help: Space-separated tenant settings in key[=value] format.

parameters.name: --update-channel
parameters.help: Specifies the update channel for the monthly Redis updates your Redis Cache will receive. Caches using "Preview" update channel get latest Redis updates at least 4 weeks ahead of "Stable" channel caches. Default value is "Stable".

parameters.name: --zonal-allocation
parameters.help: Specifies how availability zones are allocated to the Redis cache. "Automatic" enables zone redundancy and Azure will automatically select zones based on regional availability and capacity. "UserDefined" will select availability zones passed in by you using the "zones" parameter. "NoZones" will produce a non-zonal cache. If "zonal-allocation-policy" is not passed, it will be set to "UserDefined" when zones are passed in, otherwise, it will be set to "Automatic in regions where zones are supported and "NoZones" in regions where zones are not supported.

parameters.name: --zones
parameters.help: Space-separated list of availability zones into which to provision the resource.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
